name: Key Generator
description: Generate RSA / SM2 / EC / Ed25519 / Ed448 / X25519 / X448 key pairs, optionally encrypting the private key with a passphrase.

fields.encrypt: Encrypt private key with a passphrase

hints.format: The private key is emitted as PKCS#8 and the public key as SPKI by default; PKCS#1 is RSA only.
hints.encrypt: Remember the passphrase: losing it means losing the private key.

faq.q: Is the generated private key stored on the server?
faq.a: No. It is only returned in the response; nothing is written to disk or to the logs, and the browser drops it when you leave the page.

faq.q: How many RSA bits should I use?
faq.a: 2048 bits or more is the current recommendation; 1024 bits is no longer considered secure.

faq.q: How do SM2 and EC differ?
faq.a: SM2 is the Chinese national standard, typically paired with SM3 and the national PKI stack; EC is the generic elliptic curve algorithm.
